decisions.statement: The configuration read is the compiled configuration.
Naming no section gives back every section.
The item rules are a section of their own rather than rows among the ordered rules.
A section the configuration does not hold refuses the call.
A rule whose record and configured rule disagree has that disagreement named.
The records going unread is said rather than answered as agreement.
The count beside a rule counts every field past its identity rather than its conditions.

definition: the command giving back the compiled rule configuration the addon has
